github.about: Saved MCP tool-object diffs with supplemental reapproval labels and a reproducible released-version case study.
github.prerelease_notes: Experimental saved-descriptor review utility and released-version case study. The tool-descriptor-review command keeps all structural tool-object changes visible alongside incomplete historical policy labels. In a local pinned comparison of 20 adjacent transitions from 25 released versions, 14 transitions changed and seven of those produced no historical policy findings. An independent mcpdiff@0.1.0 comparison is included; classifier silence is not a false-negative label and no accuracy or reviewer-benefit claim is made. Raw third-party captures are not redistributed. The separate public-reproduction-53 synthetic regression corpus remains 53 project-authored pairs, 22 holds, 31 quiet cases and 25 findings. The private-canonical-65 research corpus and private history are excluded. The July paper is historical methods background. No external reviewer result, public reproduction, scored sealed case, live SARIF upload, ethics approval or DOI is claimed. Counterexamples and simpler existing workflows are welcome.

publication_state_scope: Snapshot at export build, not live GitHub status. archive_created means an external archival deposit, not the local source tarball.

No accuracy, reviewer-benefit, security effectiveness, external validation, benchmark status, protocol endorsement or production-readiness result is claimed.
